title: Pharmacodynamic Equivalence of Ramipril 10 mg and Atorvastatin 40 mg Administered as a Cardiovascular (CV) Polypill Acetylsalicylic Acid-Atorvastatin-Ramipril (AAR) as Compared to Monotherapy

sections.abstract: This study is to compare the pharmacodynamics of a Fixed Dose Combination Pill AAR (acetylsalicylic acid 100 mg, atorvastatin 40 mg and ramipril 10 mg) and the respective reference products, atorvastatin (Lipitor®) 40 mg and ramipril (Altace®) 10 mg.
